column2: Spec/Correctness follow-up review: PASS, no findings. The launcher integration test now covers actual TUI --check success (HTTP 200, rc 0) and unavailable-service failure (startup error, rc 1) through Windows cmd.exe with inherited ERRORLEVEL=77; isolated legacy-launcher negative control returns 77 and turns the healthy assertion red. Startup-timeout-specific and packaged-release artifact paths remain outside this test.
